name: fz521_mega_sol_sand
purpose: Mega Sol against a sandstorm's Special Defense (issue 521): Meganium-Mega, p2b, hits its ally Tyranitar with Energy Ball in a sandstorm (step 1). Sandstorm's onModifySpD reads the defender's effectiveWeather with the weather as the effect (data/conditions.ts:640-645), which is sun while the Mega Sol holder is the active Pokemon (sim/pokemon.ts:2190-2198): no 1.5x. A battle of the differential fuzzing of issue 396 (free random sets, fz_2_42), cut after its step 2: adopted as a regression fixture. The choices and the seed are those of the campaign; the trace is recorded with the pinned Showdown (b2cb775).
